final: WITH valid_rows AS (SELECT s.transref, s.optvolrt, t.tradekind FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE s.optvolrt IS NOT NULL AND t.tradekind IS NOT NULL), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as overall_avg_optvolrt FROM valid_rows), pair_stats AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) as pair_avg_optvolrt FROM valid_rows GROUP BY transref, tradekind), pair_with_deviation AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg_optvolrt, p.pair_avg_optvolrt - oa.overall_avg_optvolrt as deviation FROM pair_stats p CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa), type_avg_deviation AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation FROM pair_with_deviation GROUP BY tradekind), qualified_pairs AS (SELECT pwd.tradekind, pwd.pair_avg_optvolrt, pwd.deviation, tad.type_avg_deviation, pwd.deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation as excess FROM pair_with_deviation pwd JOIN type_avg_deviation tad ON pwd.tradekind = tad.tradekind WHERE pwd.deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM qualified_pairs GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind
